QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] The Knight's Magic Scroll
QuestInfo.0: You have defeated the #o8210004#. Now, all you have to do is find the #t2030021#. Ask #b#p2161002##k about the #t2030021#.
QuestInfo.1: #p2161002# said his scroll was used up and disappeared a long time ago, and suggested that you look for other knights who have turned into #r#o8210005##k with the #t2030021# in their possession. Eliminate the #o8210005#s and find a #b#t2030021##k.\n\n#i4032835##t4032835#  #b#c4032835##k/1
QuestInfo.2: The #t4032835# has been purified by the power of #p2161002#. Double-click #t2030021# in the Use tab of your Inventory to be taken to the Lion King's Audience Room. Gather some friends and eliminate the Lion King.

0.0: You must have the #b#t2030021##k to get to the Audience Room. This scroll has the power to transport you there, where you'll find the king. I'd give you one myself, but I used mine up, trying many times to see the king after becoming a ghost...
0.1: You'll find that some of the knights who became #o8210005#s still have their #t2030021#s. So, defeat #r#o8210005#s#k and bring me the #b#t4032835##k.

yes.0: I'll be waiting. My wish was to receive a scroll from the king as a recognition of my service. Now that I'm trying to obtain the #t2030021# like this, I feel a bit...strange.

no.0: They were once the king's knights, but they've become monsters after losing their minds. You don't have to feel guilty. If there is no way to turn them back, it would be better to...put them to rest.

1.0: You brought the #t2030021#. It's decaying... As I expected, the power of the Black Mage is slowly destroying it. But don't worry, I can activate it. One of my powers as a ghost...heh, I guess it's not all bad.

yes.0: You can use the #t2030021# now. #bDouble-click on it to travel to the Audience Room#k. But don't use it yet. You won't be able to defeat the king on your own. You must first gather others to help you.
yes.1: If you have not gone to see #r#p2161001##k yet, will you do that now? She is the wife of my dear lord. She was a beautiful queen, but her ghost is now trapped in this castle. I want nothing more than to free her from this prison. You can probably find her #rnear the #m211061000##k.

item.0: Where is the #t2030021#? You can get the #b#t2030021##k by defeating the #r#o8210005#s#k.
